source_text: Aedificant altare ingens iuxta Iordanen — scandalum. Phinees mittitur. Non in rebellionem sed testimonium: Dominus Deus noster.
pass_a_gloss: They-build altar huge beside Jordan — scandal. Phinehas is-sent. Not unto rebellion but witness: Lord God our.
pass_b_english: They build a great altar by the Jordan — a scandal. [[Phinehas is sent >> Bible:Joshua 22:13]]. Not rebellion but witness: The Lord is our God.
